failures.assertion: The PDF export command includes `--pdf` and `--allow-local-files`, with the reason that local photos are otherwise blank.
failures.evidence: The PDF line is `npx --yes @marp-team/marp-cli --no-stdin --allow-local-files slides/calm-interfaces.md -o slides/calm-interfaces.pdf`, which has `--allow-local-files` and says photos are otherwise blank, but never includes `--pdf`.

failures.assertion: States the slide count it chose for the 10-minute slot and calls it a rule of thumb, not a Marp requirement.
failures.evidence: The output says “A 10-minute slot maps to 10–15 slides” and “This deck has **11**,” but never calls that count a rule of thumb or says it is not a Marp requirement.
